description: This PHP source file defines classes and functions for handling email messages within the Webmails module of a CRM system. It includes classes for email data representation and the main Webmails class for email retrieval, parsing headers, attachments, flags, and relationships with CRM entities.

classes.name: result
classes.description: A simple class to hold decoded header parts with text and charset properties.

classes.name: Webmails
classes.description: Main class for handling email messages within the CRM Webmails module, including loading headers, attachments, body content, and CRM relationship linkage.

methods.name: load_headers
methods.description: Fetches and parses email headers for fields such as from, to, subject, date, reply-to, and CC.

methods.name: get_attachments
methods.description: Analyzes email structure to determine presence of attachments.

methods.name: load_mail
methods.description: Loads the full email message including attachments based on structure.

methods.name: searchModule
methods.description: Searches CRM modules (Leads, Contacts, Accounts) to find records related to the email sender.

methods.name: find_relationships
methods.description: Finds CRM entity relationship (Leads, Contacts, Accounts) corresponding to email sender.

methods.name: load_headers
methods.description: Fetches headers info from the email using IMAP functions.

methods.name: load_mail
methods.description: Loads email content and decomposes MIME parts into body and attachments.
